name: Self-Employed Persons Program (SEPP)

application_window.note: Intake paused 30 April 2024 (MI-72), extended indefinitely December 2025

requirements.blocker_text: This historically required at least 2 years of relevant experience (or world-class participation) in cultural activities or athletics, intending to be self-employed in Canada, assessed on a selection grid with a 35/100 pass mark — but IRCC intake has been paused indefinitely since December 2025.

sources.title: Self-employed persons program - IRCC (intake pause notice)

notes: GENUINE, DAMNING PROGRAM EVALUATION confirmed: IRCC's own 28 July 2026 program evaluation found SEPP 'no longer fit for purpose' — a rare case of a government explicitly stating its own immigration programme has failed its objectives, worth surfacing prominently rather than treating this as a routine pause. Farm-management stream closed since 2018 (pre-dating this pause). ~8,000 applications sat in inventory with processing exceeding 10 years for post-July-2022 filers, and a historical refusal rate of ~69% — meaning even before the pause, this was already one of the least successful and slowest routes across this entire multi-country dataset. Same paused/draft convention as ca_start_up_visa and us_diversity_visa. Federal Business category cap (500 PR admissions/year) shared with ca_start_up_visa.
